college.overviewHtml:
Gandhi Institute for Technology (GIFT Autonomous) is a private, self-financing autonomous institution at Gramadiha near Bhubaneswar. Founded in 2007 by Balaram Panda Trust, it offers engineering, management, computer application, applied science and research programmes.

The institute reports NAAC A++ accreditation, AICTE approval and affiliation to BPUT. Its website identifies NBA-accredited engineering departments, SIRO recognition and MSME incubation facilities. Accreditation details should be checked against the applicable certificate and validity period.

Programmes and documents

Course listings below distinguish the 2025–26 affiliation/intake document from the 2026 fee sheet. Course durations not clearly stated in the reviewed sources are left unspecified. Current eligibility and intake should be confirmed with admissions.

Campus and student facilities

Official facility pages describe laboratories, a digital library, separate hostels, Wi-Fi, backup power, dining, medical support, sports, gyms and campus transport. Campus acreage is omitted because the academic-statistics and infrastructure pages give different figures.

Reviewed 17 November 2026. Sources: Institution profile, 2025–26 approved intake, Facilities. NIRF submission data is not a NIRF ranking. No NIRF rank has been assigned here.
college.admissionHtml:
Admissions and official application

Use the official admission application portal or contact +91 7873008163 / info@gift.edu.in for programme eligibility, required entrance results, counselling, document verification and payment instructions.

No application closing date or round-wise college cutoff was verified from the reviewed institutional pages. Check the relevant counselling authority and the institute for the intended admission year.

Fees and scholarships

The 2026 Fees & Scholarships document lists separate credit-card and non-credit-card categories for some programmes. The billing period of the main course-fee table is not stated; amounts are therefore shown as published figures, not calculated total tuition.

Hostel charges are explicitly ₹37,500 per semester. Transport and lunch are each listed at ₹8,500 per semester. Hostel and college caution deposits are each ₹1,000, with stated exemptions for diploma credit-card students. Confirm inclusions, refunds and concessions before payment.

The website’s separate eligibility page describes working-professional schemes effective from 2024–25; those conditions should not be treated as universal first-year entry requirements.
college.hostelInfo:
The official hostel page describes separate accommodation for boys and girls, Wi-Fi, power backup, security/CCTV, medical support, emergency transport, laundry, recreation and dining.

The 2026 fee sheet lists ₹37,500 per semester for hostel fees and a ₹1,000 hostel caution deposit, with specific diploma and BBA/BCA concessions. Confirm room availability, inclusions and eligibility directly.

Official hostel facilities · 2026 fee sheet
college.scholarshipInfo:
The 2026 fee sheet sets out Balaram Panda Trust merit schemes A, B and C, plus stated ladies and EWS scholarships. It lists renewal conditions involving attendance and CGPA, board-related eligibility and restrictions. Scheme applicability varies by programme and student category.

The document also describes semester-based hostel concessions for certain diploma, BBA/BCA students and an attendance-linked M.Tech concession. Confirm eligibility and whether concessions can be combined before relying on a reduced fee.

Official 2026 fee and scholarship conditions. Older scholarship pages contain different amounts; the 2026 document is the current source used here.

faqsJson.question: What accreditation does the institute report?

faqsJson.question: Are the amounts in the 2026 fee sheet full-course fees?

faqsJson.question: What hostel fee is published for 2026?

faqsJson.question: What placement salary is reported in the NIRF 2026 submission?

faqsJson.question: Is a NIRF rank or official round-wise cutoff available here?
faqsJson.answer: No verified NIRF ranking award or round-wise college cutoff was established from the reviewed official pages. The linked NIRF document is a data submission, not a rank announcement.

initialBlog.title: GIFT Autonomous Bhubaneswar: Official Courses, Published Fees and Admissions Guide
initialBlog.metaDescription: A source-based guide to GIFT Autonomous programmes, 2026 published fees, hostel charges and historical placement information.
initialBlog.contentMdx:
GIFT Autonomous at a glance

Gandhi Institute for Technology is an autonomous institution near Bhubaneswar, established in 2007. Its official profile describes engineering, management, computer application, science and research study, with NAAC A++ accreditation.

Course information and intake

The college profile uses the 2025–26 BPUT affiliation letter for clearly identifiable intake figures. Its 2026 fee sheet lists additional programme labels. Applicants should confirm current-year course availability, duration and eligibility before applying.

Reading the 2026 fee schedule

The official fee document distinguishes credit-card and non-credit-card categories. Because the main programme table does not specify a billing period, its figures should not be assumed to be annual or full-course totals. Hostel fees are explicitly ₹37,500 per semester. Scholarship renewal and category restrictions are documented alongside the fee schedule.

Placement data with a defined cohort

The institution’s NIRF 2026 submission reports a ₹5.13 lakh median annual salary for its UG four-year graduates in 2024–25, with 595 students placed out of 661 graduates. This is historical, institution-submitted information. The document does not provide that cohort’s highest or average salary.

Visit and apply

The campus is at Gramadiha, Gangapada, near Bhubaneswar. Official facility pages describe laboratories, a library, hostels, dining, sports and transport. Use the official application portal, call +91 7873008163 or email info@gift.edu.in for current admission requirements.

Compiled from official institutional pages and documents checked on 17 November 2026. No independent student rating, round-wise cutoff or NIRF ranking is inferred.
